Portrait of a Smiling Elderly Man

An elderly Asian gentleman with gray hair, a neatly trimmed beard, and rectangular glasses sits comfortably in what appears to be a modern café or lobby. He wears a blue-and-white tropical print shirt, and his warm smile and relaxed posture create an inviting, casual mood. sources.description:
Dean Shek Tin Portrait

Dean Shek Tin appears at an indoor event, dressed in a white shirt and gray jacket. His clear-framed glasses and neatly trimmed white beard frame a warm, genuine smile. The dark curtains and ambient lighting in the background hint at a formal gathering or reception.

This image is featured on a Letterboxd page highlighting films starring Dean Shek Tin. The metadata confirms the source as a TMDB-hosted image linked to his actor profile, emphasizing his career in cinema.

Stone Tin at “Aces Go Places” Promotion

Stone Tin, one of the founders of Cinema City and a beloved comedic actor in Hong Kong’s film industry, attended a promotional event for the classic 1982 action-comedy “Aces Go Places.” Dressed in a gray suit and tie, he held a microphone and smiled warmly in front of a backdrop adorned with signatures. sources.title: Photograph for Film Biweekly, Dean Shek (actor, director, executive producer) (1981) - Lo Yuk Ying | Objects | M+ Museum
sources.description:
Dean Shek’s 1981 Film Biweekly Portrait

Dean Shek, the celebrated Hong Kong actor, director, and executive producer, sits center stage in a black-and-white studio portrait taken for the magazine Film Biweekly. He wears a patterned tie, a flower pinned to his lapel, and holds a cigarette, exuding a casual yet composed presence. On either side, two children in simple attire gaze toward him, one gesturing with an outstretched hand.

Candles and ornamental props fill the background, creating a theatrical atmosphere befitting a film publication. Originally published in 《電影雙周刊》, this photograph was gifted to the M+ Museum by photographer Lo Yuk Yi

sources.title: RIP Dean Shek Tin (1950-2021) — Mike Fury
sources.description:
Dean Shek Tin in Contemplation

Dean Shek Tin, renowned for his work in Hong Kong’s golden era of kung fu cinema, is shown seated in a dark suit and tie, gazing thoughtfully to one side. The wood-paneled walls and leather chair frame a formal office environment, underscoring his professional stature. His neatly groomed beard and composed expression reflect decades of experience both in front of and behind the camera.

sources.description:
Shih Tian’s Final Portraits

Veteran Hong Kong actor Shih Tian is captured in two contrasting portraits: one in monochrome, where he gazes thoughtfully with round glasses and a neatly trimmed white beard, and another in color, where he beams in a tropical-patterned shirt. These images reflect both his reflective side and his warm, approachable persona.
